=== agents/lint-docs.md mode=644
---
name: lint-docs
description: Check docs changes for broken links
tools: Bash(gh,jq), Read, Grep, Glob
model: opus
---

You are the lint-docs agent. <!-- FILL IN: one sentence on what this agent
decides, in the imperative. Keep it to the single decision the result schema
encodes. -->

## Inputs

- `ISSUE_URL` — the HTML URL of the work item this run was dispatched for.
- The target repository is checked out at the sandbox working directory.

<!-- FILL IN: any other environment variables your harness passes in
`env.sandbox`. Every variable you name here must exist in the harness, or the
agent will read an empty string at run time. -->

## Steps

1. Fetch the work item with `gh issue view "$ISSUE_URL" --json title,body,labels`.
   If the command fails, write an error result (see Output contract) and stop.
2. <!-- FILL IN: the analysis this agent performs. Be specific — name the
   files, the thresholds, and the decision boundaries. A vague step here is the
   single most common reason a custom agent produces unusable output. -->
3. <!-- FILL IN: the decision. State explicitly what makes the result `ok`
   versus `findings` versus `error`. -->

## Output contract

Write exactly one JSON object to `$FULLSEND_OUTPUT_DIR/agent-result.json`:

```json
{
  "status": "findings",
  "summary": "One line describing what you found",
  "comment": "### Findings\n\n- ...\n"
}
```

- `status` — one of `ok`, `findings`, `error`.
- `summary` — one line, at most 200 characters. Used as the comment heading.
- `comment` — Markdown body posted on the work item, at most 16384 characters.

Do not push commits, open issues, apply labels, or call any mutating API. The
post-script performs every side effect; your only output is this file.

Before you finish, run `fullsend-check-output "$FULLSEND_OUTPUT_DIR/agent-result.json"`
to catch schema violations while you can still fix them.
=== harness/lint-docs.yaml mode=644
---
# Generated by `fullsend agent new lint-docs`. Edit freely — nothing
# regenerates this file. `image:` is the fleet's current pin; pass
# --image to override it.
#
# This agent is GitHub-only. To add GitLab or Jira, see the overlays
# section of docs/guides/user/bring-your-own-agent.md.
agent: agents/lint-docs.md
description: Check docs changes for broken links
role: triage
slug: my-org-lint-docs
image: ghcr.io/fullsend-ai/fullsend-sandbox@sha256:f8255971fec8a72a60adb20f501e55098f237e699dc829f0894647c0de2a19c2
policy: policies/base.yaml
providers:
  - providers/vertex-ai.yaml
  - providers/github-ro.yaml
openshell:
  profiles:
    - profiles/fullsend-vertex-ai.yaml
    - profiles/fullsend-github-ro.yaml
host_files:
  - src: ${GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS}
    dest: /tmp/.gcp-credentials.json
  - src: ${GCP_OIDC_TOKEN_FILE}
    dest: /sandbox/workspace/.gcp-oidc-token
    optional: true
model: opus
effort: high
post_script: scripts/post-lint-docs.sh
validation_loop:
  script: scripts/validate-output-schema.sh
  schema: schemas/lint-docs-result.schema.json
  max_iterations: 2
  preflight_check: python3 -c "import jsonschema"
env:
  runner:
    FULLSEND_FORGE: github
    GH_TOKEN: ${GH_TOKEN}
    ISSUE_URL: ${GITHUB_ISSUE_URL}
  sandbox:
    ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID: ${ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID}
    CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX: "1"
    CLOUD_ML_REGION: ${CLOUD_ML_REGION}
    FULLSEND_FORGE: github
    GH_TOKEN: ${GH_TOKEN}
    GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS: /tmp/.gcp-credentials.json
    ISSUE_URL: ${GITHUB_ISSUE_URL}
timeout_minutes: 15
trigger: |
  event.transition.kind == "comment_added"
    && has(event.transition.comment.command)
    && event.transition.comment.command == "/fs-lint-docs"
    && (!has(event.state.change_proposal) || !event.state.change_proposal.is_fork)

=== schemas/lint-docs-result.schema.json mode=644
{
  "$id": "lint-docs-result.schema.json",
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "Structured output from the lint-docs agent, consumed by scripts/post-lint-docs.sh.",
  "properties": {
    "comment": {
      "maxLength": 16384,
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "ok",
        "findings",
        "error"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "summary": {
      "maxLength": 200,
      "minLength": 1,
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "status",
    "summary",
    "comment"
  ],
  "title": "lint-docs Agent Result",
  "type": "object"
}
=== scripts/post-lint-docs.sh mode=755
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# post-lint-docs.sh — turn the lint-docs agent's JSON result into one comment.
#
# Generated by `fullsend agent new`. Safe to edit.
#
# Runs on the trusted runner after the sandbox exits. The working directory is
# the run's iteration directory, so the agent output is ./output/agent-result.json.
#
# Required env:
#   ISSUE_URL — HTML URL of the work item (the harness maps GITHUB_ISSUE_URL to it)
#   GH_TOKEN  — minted by fullsend from the harness `role:` field
#
# Treat the result file as untrusted: it is model output. Only the three
# fields below are ever read, each is required to be a string, and the
# comment body is piped on stdin rather than interpolated into a command.

set -euo pipefail

: "${ISSUE_URL:?ISSUE_URL must be set}"
: "${GH_TOKEN:?GH_TOKEN must be set}"

RESULT_FILE="output/agent-result.json"
MARKER="<!-- fullsend:lint-docs-agent -->"
MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS=200
MAX_COMMENT_CHARS=16384

if [[ ! -f "${RESULT_FILE}" ]]; then
  echo "post-lint-docs: ${RESULT_FILE} not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! jq -e . "${RESULT_FILE}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "post-lint-docs: ${RESULT_FILE} is not valid JSON" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Field allowlist: anything else in the file is ignored by construction.
status=$(jq -r 'if (.status | type) == "string" then .status else empty end' "${RESULT_FILE}")
summary=$(jq -r 'if (.summary | type) == "string" then .summary else empty end' "${RESULT_FILE}")
comment=$(jq -r 'if (.comment | type) == "string" then .comment else empty end' "${RESULT_FILE}")

case "${status}" in
  ok|findings|error) ;;
  *) echo "post-lint-docs: status must be ok, findings or error (got '${status}')" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
[[ -n "${summary}" ]] || { echo "post-lint-docs: summary is required" >&2; exit 1; }
[[ -n "${comment}" ]] || { echo "post-lint-docs: comment is required" >&2; exit 1; }
if (( ${#summary} > MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS )); then
  echo "post-lint-docs: summary exceeds ${MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS} characters" >&2
  exit 1
fi
# Truncate to MAX_COMMENT_CHARS *including* the marker, so the result never
# exceeds the cap the schema declares.
TRUNCATION_MARKER=$'\n\n_(truncated)_'
if (( ${#comment} > MAX_COMMENT_CHARS )); then
  keep=$(( MAX_COMMENT_CHARS - ${#TRUNCATION_MARKER} ))
  if (( keep < 0 )); then keep=0; fi
  comment="${comment:0:${keep}}${TRUNCATION_MARKER}"
fi

if [[ "${status}" == "ok" ]]; then
  echo "post-lint-docs: status=ok, nothing to post" >&2
  exit 0
fi

# Derive the repo and number from the work item URL rather than trusting extra
# environment. The pattern also rejects anything that is not a github.com URL.
url_re='^https://github[.]com/([A-Za-z0-9._-]+/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+)/(issues|pull)/([0-9]+)$'
if [[ ! "${ISSUE_URL}" =~ ${url_re} ]]; then
  echo "post-lint-docs: ISSUE_URL is not a GitHub issue or pull request URL" >&2
  exit 1
fi
REPO="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
NUMBER="${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"

if [[ "${POST_LINT_DOCS_DRY_RUN:-}" == "1" ]]; then
  printf '**%s**\n\n%s\n' "${summary}" "${comment}"
  echo "post-lint-docs: dry run, not posting" >&2
  exit 0
fi

# fullsend issues post-comment is the repo's sticky-comment primitive: it
# finds this agent's previous comment by marker and edits it in place, so
# re-runs do not flood the work item.
printf '**%s**\n\n%s\n' "${summary}" "${comment}" \
  | fullsend issues post-comment \
      --tracker github \
      --project "${REPO}" \
      --number "${NUMBER}" \
      --marker "${MARKER}" \
      --result -
=== scripts/validate-output-schema.sh mode=755 (shared, written only when absent)
